name: Recooty
description: Recooty is an AI-powered hiring platform to create job descriptions, post to job boards, and manage applicants.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Recooty to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Recooty to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.recooty.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Recooty MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Recooty provides these MCP tools: create-department, create-job-posting, create-location, list-departments, list-job-postings, and list-locations.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Recooty?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Recooty in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Recooty requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Recooty is developed by Recooty Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
